Check the inputs of build_survival_panel()

dot-check_survival_args.Rd

Shared by the data.frame and tbl_dbi methods, so the checks cannot drift apart. Stops with an error if only one of contracts and salary_col is given, if a required column is missing from personnel or contracts, or if a covariate is in both tables (ambiguous) or in neither.

Usage

.check_survival_args(
  personnel,
  contracts,
  tenure_col,
  salary_col,
  status_col,
  covariate_cols,
  personnel_id_col,
  ref_date_col,
  contract_id_col
)

Arguments

personnel, contracts

The personnel and contract tables, as data frames or lazy database tables. contracts may be NULL.

tenure_col, salary_col, status_col

Character. The tenure (in personnel), pay (in contracts, or NULL) and employment status (in personnel, or NULL) columns.

covariate_cols

Character vector or NULL. Covariates, each from exactly one of the two tables.

personnel_id_col, ref_date_col, contract_id_col

Character. The person, snapshot date and contract id columns.

Value

NULL, invisibly.
